nodes.label: Lexicon orchestrator checkpoint (through phase 08)
nodes.rationale: Phase 08 was a no-op because browse was already met by additive lexicon code: LexiconBuilder joins forms to bt_* without rewriting those tables, and LexiconQueryService reads only lexicon_* tables. Shared normalizers were already public, so dictionary and morphology query modules needed no new helpers. Locked at this date: morphology.sqlite3 is the canonical working lexicon database, bt_* stay curated, TUI v1 is browse only, and dictionary or morphology product edits need human approval.

nodes.label: morphology.sqlite3 as lexicon database
nodes.rationale: On 2026-06-28 the lexicon orchestration locked morphology.sqlite3 as the canonical working lexicon database. The July 3 canonical-db handoff never names that filename; it puts lexicon DDL in the Alembic canonical schema. Whether that fully retires morphology.sqlite3 is not stated.

nodes.label: LexiconBuilder
nodes.rationale: The builder joins forms to bt_* with direct SQL and local _select_entry_id and _WORDCLASS_TO_BT_POS logic. Lexicon build never rewrites bt_* tables; those stay curated dictionary data.

nodes.label: LexiconQueryService
nodes.rationale: Unified search, the orphan section, and details are served from lexicon_* read-model tables only, which is why phase 08 did not need to edit dictionary or morphology query cores.
